name: Accent Hold
description: Type accented and special characters without a daemon or root. Press Ctrl+Super with a base letter (e, a, c, o, n …), then pick the accented variant you want (é è ê ë, ç, ñ, ô …) from a clean popup. Add Shift for uppercase variants. The chosen character is injected wherever your cursor is, including text fields, editors and the terminal. A built-in preferences panel lets you customize the popup delay, character table and active keyboard layouts.
